title: Exclude a historical C5 caller with a common-cut23 bound
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Excludes the literal historical P112 independent-piece caller `2,3,4^2,7^6` at code-intersection dimension at least six. The new common-cut theorem says that **one common set of at most 23 live sites admits at most three projective directions** whose residual binary support rank is at most seven, over every characteristic-zero field using the standard E8 Weyl-chamber theorem.

The caller's four small pieces cover at most `2+4+8+8=22` sites, while its quotient requires six independent directions. The finite ingredients are: every root-normal/seven-space intersection contains at most 32 off-sites, so live normals need at least 21 deletions; four distinct E8 root normals share at most 14 live off-sites. Four qualifying directions under one common 23-site cut would require at least `4*21-3*23=15`, contradiction. A two-independent-direction fixture works at 22 sites. Attainment of three and sharpness of 23 are unclaimed.

[Proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/af26d5be8e1f684e96da080160593bd3bd7accd8/research/p112-common-cut23-caller/PROOF.md) and [package](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/af26d5be8e1f684e96da080160593bd3bd7accd8/research/p112-common-cut23-caller). Scientific commit af26d5be8e1f684e96da080160593bd3bd7accd8 adds ten package files. A concurrently added separate commit, [ce148e5aa2bbdc6f420e8a6cf6935e37d5b54cd2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/ce148e5aa2bbdc6f420e8a6cf6935e37d5b54cd2), carries the existing #3885 P112 runner-context repair. The current PR has two commits and eleven changed files. Its research package and all declared input bytes are unchanged. No full C5, physical supplier, paid-profile improvement, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Task and overlap

User-directed C5 application audit following #3885/#3163, with uniform normal-plane investigation conditional on its usefulness. Card complex-rank-shape-decoder, explicitly changed scope in TASK.json. The actual small footprint already forces root normals; the new support lemma closes a named caller without a global normal-plane census. That global question remains unsettled by this package.

Base: 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90, refreshed unchanged before publication; priority revision 6. Scientific contribution: af26d5be8e1f684e96da080160593bd3bd7accd8. Current publication head including the separate workflow repair: ce148e5aa2bbdc6f420e8a6cf6935e37d5b54cd2. Relevant heads: #3163 89419106cd86896c366e853795978f1bc85f9112; #3289 e8570c50f9591c9ca653a527ed9626aaa703c3bc; #3322 131605e644ec2aa78834d8707fe79bb05f44d169; #3405 4c5e080c93c5d6fc3b744c598d9c9e6e0ba9dd19. All live inputs are pinned canonical-base Git blobs/SHA256; no foreign runtime history is needed.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19030442). Entry and final overlap each covered 633 distinct open PR bodies, seven REST pages plus an empty eighth, and local notes/ledger. Browser-loaded C5 text/replies and latest handoffs were inspected. Discussion coverage is partial: 41 rendered permalinks versus the 72-comment header after our claim; load-more did not establish complete pagination. The helper's all-board refresh failed without gh. Arbitrary diffs, all closed bodies and unpublished work are nonexhaustive; no novelty certificate is claimed.

Composing #3289's 65/69 fixed historical inventory with the explicit conditional #3322 and #3405 caller contracts gives 67/69. This new caller makes **68/69 in that named conditional inventory**, leaving 4,5^3,6^6 uncertified by it. This is not a global unresolved count. The inherited successor scientific censuses and dependencies were not independently recertified.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, Linux x86-64; standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-common-cut23-caller
```

- Registered replay passed all three commands; the final added semantic mutation was separately rerun with the complete controls command.
- Exact primary: 43,435 seven-spaces, 5,212,200 root/space tests, 8,214,570 fourfold intersections. All original caller coordinates and the label-bit permutation match. Chamber facts, reflection closure and the evaluation Gram matrix are checked.
- Separate implementation imports no primary routines: lattice-shell reconstruction, rational coordinates, RREF annihilators and pair-join enumeration reproduce both complete histograms. Same-session computational corroboration is not independent human review.
- Eight actual optimized rejecting CLI runs, a positive optimized CLI, four invalid proof-budget controls, a false 15-site intersection rejected by the actual mathematics gate, and separate/common-cut controls. Four independent normals each permit 21 separate deletions, but their union has 66 sites.
- PR3289's bounded registered composition replay and independent role scan/controls passed; inherited geometric premises remain conditional.
- Published-byte/source-history preflight passes for 17 files at both the scientific commit and current head ce148e5aa2bbdc6f420e8a6cf6935e37d5b54cd2. The official committed export passes its offline integrity check. All three actual scripts passed from the **committed, read-only, Git-free export** under optimized Python 3.12.3: 5.87 s primary, 4.23 s separate implementation, 34.50 s controls. All 18 exported hashes, including the export receipt, stayed unchanged. Single-run timings are not benchmarks.

[CHECKS.json](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/af26d5be8e1f684e96da080160593bd3bd7accd8/research/p112-common-cut23-caller/CHECKS.json) records the pre-publication evidence and limits. Syntax/JSON/whitespace checks pass. Local Ruff crashed before diagnostics; no lint PASS is claimed.

Hosted scientific CI is unverified. [Fork push run39200013787](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39200013787) failed immediately with zero jobs in the unchanged P112 workflow addressed by separate repair #3885. No new verifier executed there. The later ce148e5a commit changes only that workflow’s TMPDIR initialization, matching the existing repair; its package bytes match the tested scientific commit. At 04:37 UTC the fork Actions API listed zero runs on the repaired head, so no hosted replay or parser-acceptance result is inferred. Independent human/proof-kernel review, full historical FINITE/C5 and inherited successor suites, selected cold replay, native/physical/supplier admission, upstream P112 manual execution, Lean and Docker are unrun.

Credit joaqcoo and the retained E8/P112/root-code lineage. Frozen predecessors and Apache-2.0 notices are preserved. Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance throughout; no independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

Smallest next task: independently inspect PROOF.md sections 1-4 and replay both finite histograms before adopting this exclusion. The distinct 4,5^3,6^6 caller needs actual coefficient/support reconciliation; its 44-site allowance is outside this theorem and normal-plane exclusion alone does not close it. Structured next questions are in the package. No continuing reservation or construction expansion is proposed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated package. The separate P112 workflow commit only moves TMPDIR initialization into a runner step. Other workflows, existing scientific checkers, frozen inputs, priorities and selected science are unchanged.
